about: Every place the estate decided what words MEAN by matching them, from the word-matching audit of 23 Sep 2026 (class i: a decision about meaning that must become reasoning). founder_instruction 886-903: 'NO word matching anywhere'. 'migrated' = the meaning now comes from _shared/think.ts and its 'proof' is enforced by scripts/checks/decision_points_are_reasoned.test.mjs. 'pending' = still word-decided, in the order they will be migrated (customer-facing and money first). A regex that guards OUR outgoing text, or parses a format, is not listed: the ruling permits it.

parsePeriod (/annual|monthly|renew|your plan/), vendorFromAddress + VENDOR_NAMES (the sender domain spelled into a vendor) decided how often a receipt bills and who issued it; now documentKind (cadence among the options) and receiptVendor (a known vendor, else the name as the document writes it) reason them; the amount beside its currency mark, the date, VAT and TRN stay format parsing
points.held: Held: the receipt is not booked on a word guess. It is archived and handed to the bookkeeper (fn_receipt_hand_to_bookkeeper, [HELD — nothing booked: who issued this waits for reasoning]) and the question waits in the accountant queue (dedupe expense_vendor:<email id>); when the hold lifts reasoned_delivery re-runs the expense_sweep for that email, which books it.

must_contain: read_as: ex.read_as ?? null, renews_item: ex.renews_item ?? null

points.decides: isBankStatement (/mashreq/ and /statement/ over the sender, subject, filenames and the rebuilt rows) decided whether an email was a bank statement; now documentKind reasons it over the same envelope and the statement rows (statementRowText), and takeInStatement runs only for a message reasoned to be one
points.held: Held: nothing is taken in as a statement on a word guess; the email is held for the bookkeeper like an unreadable receipt and the question waits in the accountant queue (dedupe expense_kind:<email id>); on replay reasoned_delivery re-runs the expense_sweep for it, which takes the statement in.

points.decides: isReceiptish: a subject regex (receipt|invoice|payment|renewal|billing|funded...) and a sender regex (billing|invoice|stripe) decided whether an email took the receipt path; now the mailbox the sender addressed (structured) routes finance mail, and any other email is reasoned by documentKind
points.held: Held: an email to a non-finance mailbox takes the supplier-document path, which stores it and classifies nothing on a guess; the question waits in the accountant queue (dedupe expense_kind:<email id>), and if it is reasoned to be an expense document reasoned_delivery hands the stored email to the bookkeeper.

points.decides: description ~* gl_settings.bank_charge_pattern / owner_transfer_pattern / bank_interest_pattern (+ fn_bank_line_is_owner_transfer), ilike '%stripe%' in the payout reconciliation, vendor ~* the Meta and renewal vendor patterns, and vendor ilike '%name%' in the expense duty decided what a bank line or a booked expense IS; now bank_statement_line.kind (reasoned by bankLineKind each duties tick, or applied on replay) and expense_entries.read_as / renews_item (reasoned when booked) carry the meaning, and the patterns are deleted
points.held: Held: a line stays kind NULL and no routine books it; the question waits in the accountant queue (dedupe bank_line:<id>) and fn_reason_apply_accountant__bank_line records the kind when the hold lifts; a credit still unreasoned past the matching window is an accountant finding ("not reasoned yet"), never booked on a guess.

points.decides: classifyReply: ordered decline/later/positive regex lists (EN and AR) chose the follow-up and whether the prospect was closed as declined; now replyClass reasons the reply against the message it answers
points.held: Held: the reply is recorded as replied with no class, nobody is closed and no follow-up is drafted on a guess; it waits in the marketing queue (dedupe outreach_reply:<mark token>) and on replay fn_marketing_outreach_reply_reasoned records the class, closes a decline and adds the composed follow-up.

must_contain: cls: ReplyClass): { cls: ReplyClass; message: string; lint: Finding[] }

points.decides: a regex over Twilio's English error message (approv|not yet approved|template pending|63016|63042) decided that a rejected send was a template awaiting approval and kept it queued; now Twilio's structured error code decides (twilioVerdict), and a rejection with no code is unknown and retried
points.held: No model is involved: the decision is the provider's structured code. A rejection without a code is treated as unknown and the row stays queued for the next tick (never read off the prose, never dropped).

points.decides: a regex over the model's transcript (no speech|silence|inaudible|no audio|blank|empty) decided there was no speech, so a caller who said "silence" got nothing; now the model returns {speech, text} and its structured speech field decides
points.held: Held/unreadable: a transcriber reply that is not the {speech, text} object is not guessed at; the caller gets transcription_failed (unreadable) and is asked to record again. Under the paid hold the gateway refuses as before.

points.decides: order by (reason ilike '%incident response%') over event_subscription chose an incident's owner (no subscriber exists, so every incident fell to the non-existent 'security'); now an incident belongs to the it_engineer seat, and a writer that names an owner keeps it
points.held: No reasoning is needed: the owner is structured (the founder's seat for incidents), so nothing waits under the hold.

points.decides: support_knowledge and ceo_knowledge carried no vector column, so fn_reason_retrieve could not read them by meaning, and fn_support_knowledge_search / fn_ceo_knowledge_search ranked by websearch_to_tsquery with a best-terms OR fallback; now both carry embedding_gte (gte-small), are read by vector distance only (over the 0.84 corroboration floor), are embedded on write by their loaders, and a changed row's vector is cleared by trigger
points.held: Not a model decision: retrieval is gte-small, free and in-region, which the hold does not reach. A row with no vector yet (before the backfill runs) is simply not retrieved; nothing falls back to words.

must_contain: alter table public.support_knowledge add column if not exists embedding_gte vector(384);
p_query: query, p_embedding: vec ? '[' + vec.join(',') + ']' : null,

Nobody is handed off on a guess.
